newsitem.title: USA: Abbey National files $3.9 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National files $3.9 bln shelf debt.

text.p: Abbey National Plc filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $3.915 billion in debt securities.
When combined with a previous filing, Abbey National will have a total of $4 billion in debt securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to fund the business and strengthen the capital base, the banking group said in the filing.
Abbey National is the fourth largest banking group in the United Kingdom in terms of assets, with total assets of 103.1 billion stg and shareholder funds of 3.9 billion stg as of December 31, 1995.
The group's business, based in London, focuses on providing financial services to individuals in the UK, particularly secured residential mortgage loans and investment and savings products.
